newsitem.title: UK: MSAS Spain new MD and ISO 9002 for Madrid.
newsitem.headline: MSAS Spain new MD and ISO 9002 for Madrid.

text.p: International freight forwarder MSAS Cargo International has appointed Teresa Vitch as managing director of its Spanish company, MSAS Cargo International SA.
Vich, previously station manager in Madrid, has 13 years domestic and international experience in the industry. She has been on the Spanish board of directors since 1994, MSAS said in a statement.

In July this year the Madrid office gained the ISO 9002 award for all forwarding services from there making MSAS the first freight forwarders in Spain to be accredited by the Spanish Association for Standardization and Certification (AENOR).

Vich said: "My first goal as managing director will be to strengthen and build on the excellent Spanish team, so as to continue to provide our customers with the high level of service that they have come to expect from MSAS in Spain."

"A plan is also in place to ensure the successful implementation of ISO 9002 throughout Spain, so that our other offices, in Barcelona and Alicante, are accredited as soon as possible," she added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
